staff-empty: Nobody works at this restaurant on BiteTribe yet.
staff-add-hint: The person needs a BiteTribe account already. Add them with the email address they signed up with.
staff-already-added: That account is already on your staff. Nothing changed.
staff-add-failed: We couldn't add that account. Check the email address and try again.
staff-remove-confirm-message: They lose access to the business app, but it can take up to an hour for a session they already have open to end.
staff-remove-failed: We couldn't remove that account. Please try again.
table-plan-empty: This restaurant has no published rooms yet. An owner lays the floor plan out and publishes it, and the room shows up here.
table-plan-load-failed: We couldn't load this room. Please try again.
table-plan-room-empty: This room has no tables yet.
table-plan-hint: Tap a table to see it. Hold it, or press enter, for what you can do with it. Drag to move the plan, pinch to zoom.
table-plan-actions-pending: Changing a table's state is coming next.
table-plan-canvas-label: Live plan of {{room}}. Tab walks the tables one by one and leaves the plan after the last of them, enter opens the selected table, drag to move the plan, pinch or plus and minus to zoom, zero to fit.
floor-plan-empty: This restaurant has no rooms yet. A room is the surface everything else is placed on, so start with one and give it the size of the real space.
floor-plan-load-failed: We couldn't load this floor plan. Please try again.
floor-plan-room-floor-hint: Optional. Rooms sharing a name here are listed together, such as Ground floor or Upstairs.
floor-plan-delete-confirm-message: The room and everything drawn in it are removed. Tables have to be moved or deleted first.
floor-plan-room-save-failed: We couldn't save this room. Please try again.
floor-plan-room-delete-failed: We couldn't delete this room. Please try again.
floor-plan-room-conflict: Somebody else saved this room while you were editing it. What you see now is what is stored — check it and save again.
floor-plan-room-gone: This room was deleted on another device, so your changes were not saved.
floor-plan-room-not-empty: This room still holds {{count}} table(s). Move or delete them first.
floor-plan-restaurant-summary: {{rooms}} room(s), {{tables}} table(s), {{seats}} seat(s) across the restaurant.
floor-plan-discard-message: Everything you have arranged since the last publish is removed, and the room goes back to the published plan. This cannot be undone.
floor-plan-snap-hint: Snapping decides where the next measurement lands. It never moves anything already on the plan.
floor-plan-canvas-label: Floor plan of {{room}}. Tab walks the objects one by one and leaves the plan after the last of them, drag an object to move it, arrow keys to nudge the selection or to pan when nothing is selected, shift and an arrow to nudge further, delete to remove, escape to cancel, plus and minus to zoom, zero to fit.
floor-plan-canvas-hint: Tab walks the objects on the plan one at a time and lets go after the last of them. Arrow keys nudge whatever is selected, or pan the plan when nothing is.
floor-plan-zoom-fit: Fit the room to the view
floor-plan-palette-hint: Drag an object on to the plan, or activate it to place it in the middle of the view. Copy the first table instead of dragging twenty.
floor-plan-object-table-hint: This is where the table stands. Its number and how many people it seats are in the table card below.
floor-plan-table-label-empty: A table needs a number. Staff call it out and it is printed next to the QR code.
floor-plan-table-label-taken: {{label}} is already in use in {{room}}. Table numbers are unique across the whole restaurant, so this table kept the one it had.
floor-plan-table-room-hint: A table keeps its number and its QR code when it moves, so a code already printed stays valid.
floor-plan-table-moved: {{label}} moved to {{room}}. Save the room to store it.
floor-plan-table-disabled-hint: This table stays on the plan and is drawn differently. It takes no guests and gets no QR code.
floor-plan-numbering-hint: {{count}} tables are selected. They are numbered from the top left of the room down, and numbers already used elsewhere in the restaurant are skipped.
floor-plan-unpublished-changes: This plan has changes that are not published yet.
floor-plan-published: Plan published. Staff and QR codes now read it.
floor-plan-publish-blocked: This plan cannot be published yet. Fix the errors listed under the room.
floor-plan-publish-confirm-message: The published plan is what staff see and what a scanned QR code resolves against. This is what changes:
floor-plan-change-floor: The room moves to another floor grouping.
floor-plan-change-nothing: Nothing changes. The draft matches the published plan.
floor-plan-draft-discarded: Draft discarded. You are back on the published plan.
floor-plan-draft-discard-failed: We couldn't discard this draft. Please try again.
floor-plan-draft-conflict: Somebody else is arranging this room on another device, so your changes are no longer being stored. Publish them, or discard them and start from what is stored.
floor-plan-autosave-idle: Your changes are stored as a draft while you work. Nothing is live until you publish.
floor-plan-autosave-saved: Draft stored. Nothing is live until you publish.
floor-plan-autosave-failed: We couldn't store the draft. Your changes are still on screen.
floor-plan-autosave-blocked: The draft is not being stored, because somebody else is arranging this room on another device.
floor-plan-issue-label-empty: A table has no number. Give it one before publishing.
floor-plan-issue-label-duplicate: {{label}} is used twice. Table numbers are unique across the whole restaurant.
floor-plan-issue-seats-too-few: Table {{label}} seats nobody. Give it a capacity of at least one.
floor-plan-issue-table-outside-room: Table {{label}} is outside the room. Move it back in, or make the room larger.
floor-plan-issue-table-overhangs-room: Table {{label}} sticks out past the room outline.
floor-plan-qr-codes-blocked: Publish this plan before printing QR codes, so every table has a code.
qr-sheets-load-failed: We couldn't load the codes for this restaurant. Please try again.
qr-sheets-empty: There are no tables in service to print a code for. Add tables to the floor plan and put them in service first.
qr-sheets-layout-sticker-hint: Twelve codes to an A4 sheet. Print on label paper and stick one on each table.
qr-sheets-layout-tent-hint: One large code per A4 page, for a card that stands on the table.
qr-sheets-disabled: {{count}} table(s) are out of service and get no code: {{labels}}.
qr-sheets-missing: These tables have no code yet: {{labels}}. Reload the page to try again.
